gotchas: One page (Azure AD B2C): first name (#givenName), last name (#surname), password (#newPassword) and its confirmation (#reenterPassword), email (#email), a required mobile phone (input[id*="phone" i]), a country select (United States by default) and a required marketing yes/no choice (label:text-is("No")), then #continue. The vault's default 24-character password was accepted.
The mobile phone is required and is the account owner's to supply; on 2026-10-01 no text-message step followed submit.
After submit, a welcome page with the member number asks to verify the email by a link sent by email. The link belongs to the account owner.

Sign-in (/guestrewards/account-overview.html) is #signInName and the password, then #next. From a new browser, once the password is accepted, the page moves to a step that sends a new-login code by email ('Send code'). That code belongs to the account owner: hand it off.
notes: Discovered by scripts/signup-selectors.ts (session arm); driven through the Agent Vault proxy on 2026-10-01, see evidence.
